about: Differences between this server's catalog and PostgreSQL 16.11 (reference/pg16-catalog.json), each with a reason. status 'accepted' follows from what the server is: a Calcite-backed SQL front end for BI and IDE clients, with no storage engine, replication, statistics collector, foreign data wrappers or full-text search, and with exotic types flattened to text. status 'gap' is a defect to fix; remove its entry when fixed. The server declares PostgreSQL 14, so a column PostgreSQL added in 15 or 16 is accepted, and one added in 14 or earlier is a gap.

unserved.reason: No statistics collector, WAL, replication or background workers: the server is a SQL front end over Calcite adapters, so these views have nothing to report.

Lineage tools read view dependencies; serve them from the view definitions.
